decision: No candidate is verified for production Region -> Governorate use.

candidates.operator: General Authority for Survey and Geospatial Information (GEOSA)
candidates.dataset_name: Geographical Names — feature type and aggregate count XLSX
candidates.access_method: Public open-data catalog download; workbook inspected locally.
administrative_levels: feature classes include regions, governorates, centers, villages; no unit-level roster

stable_ids.evidence: Workbook provides feature-type code/class and aggregate count only; it has no individual administrative-unit rows or IDs.

parent_relationships.evidence: No region-governorate-city membership rows or parent IDs in the inspected workbook.

candidates.last_updated: Catalog page has a 2026 web update; workbook metadata timestamps are not a dataset effective date/version.
candidates.license: GEOSA catalog states open-data reuse is subject to the applicable dataset license and attribution; no dataset-specific license was identified in the inspected workbook.
candidates.completeness_evidence: The XLSX is a class/count summary, not a list of geographic units; administrative completeness cannot be measured from it.

candidates.operator: General Authority for Survey and Geospatial Information (GEOSA)
candidates.access_method: Public product page; page describes digital GeoPDF/GeoTIFF delivery on request. No structured data package requested or received.
administrative_levels: administrative regions; product is a general topographic map

stable_ids.evidence: Public product description does not expose an administrative-unit ID table.

parent_relationships.evidence: No structured region-governorate-city parent relation published on the product page.

candidates.dataset_version: Product page identifies production year 2026; this is not a structured dataset version.
candidates.license: No dataset-specific reuse license was established for a requested map deliverable.
candidates.completeness_evidence: Product page describes national map coverage but not a downloadable administrative-unit roster.
blocking_gaps: No stable IDs or parent keys

candidates.operator: National Center for Archives and Records (NCAR)
candidates.dataset_name: Unified Coding Guide for Regions, Governorates and Administrative Centers
candidates.access_method: Public webpage and linked 80-page PDF; human-readable guide, not a machine-readable download.

stable_ids.evidence: Guide shows 13 region codes 0001–0013 and assigns codes to governorates and centers; code persistence contract is not documented.

parent_relationships.evidence: PDF indexes region sections and nests governorate/center lists under each region; no machine-readable parent key is published.

candidates.dataset_version: PDF cover indicates issuance 1448; no explicit dataset version found.
candidates.last_updated: PDF file metadata indicates 2026-07-28; file metadata is not an effective date.
candidates.license: No explicit reuse license located in the reviewed page or PDF.
candidates.completeness_evidence: Guide index and code page cover 13 regions; the PDF is manually structured and does not supply a machine-readable completeness/count statement adequate for deterministic import.
blocking_gaps: Custodian's current roster/version role needs confirmation

candidates.operator: Ta’adeen GIS public ArcGIS service; underlying data custodian not established
candidates.access_method: Public ArcGIS REST metadata and feature queries; no authentication required for observed reads.

stable_ids.evidence: Observed Governorate_Code was unique across 149 governorate records; Emirate_Code/Emirate_ID unique across 13 regions; CITY_ID had 3,659 distinct values for 3,661 city rows and is not fully unique in this snapshot. Stability is not contractually documented.

parent_relationships.evidence: Governorate parent is region name strings with no region ID/relationship; city governorate name matching is incomplete and no ArcGIS relationship is defined.

candidates.last_updated: Governorate/city observed last-edited date 2024-10-29; region rows include later edits through 2026-05-12. These are edit timestamps, not dataset effective dates.
candidates.license: No applicable reuse license found in layer metadata; copyrightText is blank.
candidates.completeness_evidence: Observed services expose national layer counts but counts conflict with GASTAT publications; no source authority or completeness statement resolves the difference.
blocking_gaps: City IDs not unique in observed snapshot

candidates.operator: National Center for Meteorology (NCM) hosted TileServer; source cited as GASTAT statistical boundaries
candidates.dataset_name: Vector tiles: KSA_Regions, KSA_Governorates, and cities
candidates.access_method: Public TileServer catalog and TileJSON metadata.

stable_ids.evidence: Governorate TileJSON includes Govern_ID and Region_ID; region TileJSON exposes region attributes; city tiles expose city_id but uniqueness is not proven by the sampled tile statistics.

parent_relationships.evidence: Governorate tile attributes explicitly include Region_ID; cities expose region_id but no governorate parent ID.

candidates.last_updated: Source field cites statistical boundaries map dated 2019-06-20; no tile dataset last-updated date found.
candidates.license: No reuse license found in TileServer index or TileJSON metadata.
candidates.completeness_evidence: TileJSON reports those counts; source is a 2019 statistical boundary map. City tilestats sample values do not certify unique IDs or full administrative coverage.

candidates.operator: Saudi Post / SPL National Address API
candidates.dataset_name: National Address lookup APIs — Regions and Cities
candidates.access_method: Documented subscription API; authenticated requests require an access token/subscription key. No call made without credentials.

stable_ids.evidence: Public API documentation describes IDs and Arabic/English names; persistence/version guarantees are not documented on these endpoint pages.

fields: RegionId request parameter for city listing
parent_relationships.evidence: Cities endpoint accepts RegionId=-1 to list all cities or a region-specific value; no city-to-governorate dataset is documented.

candidates.license: API Terms of Use apply; terms are account/API-use terms and don't establish a reusable governorate register or unrestricted data reuse.
candidates.completeness_evidence: No authorized response was obtained; documentation describes Regions/Cities only and does not document a governorate lookup endpoint.

candidates.access_method: Public statistical methodology pages and reports.

stable_ids.evidence: Publications report totals and statistical coverage; no versioned administrative membership IDs provided in the reviewed materials.

parent_relationships.evidence: No unit-level roster or explicit parent keys in the reviewed methodology publications.

candidates.last_updated: The 2025 Health and Safety at Work methodology states latest methodology update 2026-04-29; other products have their own publication pages.
candidates.license: Statistical publication terms; not an administrative reference dataset license.
candidates.completeness_evidence: Counts describe different statistical products/frames; no membership lists reconcile 150 versus 151.
blocking_gaps: Statistical scope is not an administrative register
